subtitle: Authorized accounts are checked when you open the page (results under 10 minutes old are reused). WorkBuddy's endpoint is risk-gated, so it's only queried when you click.
notConfigured: The creditSummary endpoint is not configured, so credits cannot be queried.
noAccounts: No queryable WorkBuddy account yet — add one on the WorkBuddy page first.
networkFailed: Network unreachable. Check your connection or proxy, then retry.
parseFailed: Failed to parse the balance response
cursorAutoPoolHint: Includes Cursor Grok and Composer; beyond limits consumes Other Models quota or on-demand spend
grokExhausted: Included usage exhausted for this cycle
grokPooledEnterprise: Enterprise pooled allowance — no personal percentage
grokNoIncluded: This account has no Grok Bot included allowance
codexNoLimits: No limit windows returned for this plan

authHint.codex: Click Authorize and sign in to ChatGPT in your browser; you'll be brought back here to check the Codex quota.
authHint.cursor: Click Authorize and sign in to Cursor in your browser; you'll be brought back here to check usage.
authHint.grok-bot: Grok Bot uses Cursor accounts: click Authorize and sign in to the matching account in your browser.
authHint.workbuddy: Scan to sign in to a CodeBuddy account; it joins the account pool and its credits become queryable.
authHint.deepseek: DeepSeek has no authorization link — enter a platform API key to check the balance (stored on this machine only).
authHint.qoder: Click Authorize and sign in to Qoder (qoder.cn) in your browser; you will be brought back here to check Credits usage.
authHint.claude: Import OAuth from local Claude Code, or paste an access token. Claude Code and Desktop share the same accounts.
authHint.zcode: Enter a Zhipu BigModel platform API key to check ZCode quota (stored on this machine only).
authHint.mimo: Enter a Xiaomi MiMo API key: sk- for pay-as-you-go balance; tp- / ttp- verifies a Token Plan key (usage needs a platform sign-in; sessions auto-renew when possible, re-sign-in if passport expires; stored on this machine only).

mimoReplaceHint: Enter a new API key; it replaces this card after verification (the old key is removed).
mimoNoData: No balance or usage information returned
mimoVerifiedNoUsage: Key is valid. Sign in to the platform to query Token Plan usage (sessions auto-renew when possible).
mimoLoginPending: Sign in in the opened window, then click Done
mimoCookieHint: On the platform usage page: F12 → Network → any api/v1 request → copy the full Cookie (must include api-platform_serviceToken and userId; prefer Sign in for usage so auto-renew can work).
mimoSessionExpired: Session expired (auto-renew failed) — sign in again
claudeNoWindows: No usage windows returned for this account
claudeReplaceHint: Paste a new OAuth access token; it replaces this card after verification.
zcodeReplaceHint: Enter a new API key; it replaces this card after verification (the old key is removed).
authPending: {{name}} authorization page opened in your browser — waiting for sign-in…
authPendingShort: Authorization page opened in your browser — waiting for sign-in…
removeAccountMessage: Delete the authorization tokens stored on this machine for "{{name}}"? The card is removed too; you'll need to authorize again to query it.
boardEmpty: No cards on the board yet — click + under "Add account" on the right to authorize one.
dsReplaceHint: Enter a new API key. Once verified it replaces this card (the old key is deleted).
wbIdle: Not checked yet (WorkBuddy is never queried automatically)
refreshAllHint: Query the Cursor / Grok Bot / Codex / DeepSeek accounts on the board in parallel; WorkBuddy refreshes separately.
refreshWbHint: WorkBuddy's quota endpoint is risk-gated: accounts are queried one by one (2 s apart), only when you click.
railNoAccounts: No authorized accounts yet — start from "Add account" below.
railShowAccount: Hidden — click to show and locate
railCancelAuth: Waiting for browser sign-in — click to cancel
checkinAllHint: Check in the WorkBuddy accounts on the board that haven't checked in today, one by one (2 s apart); credits refresh afterwards.
checkinAutoOff: Auto check-in is off (set it under Daily schedule)
qoderEnterprise: Enterprise usage is managed by your organization; view it on the web.
qoderClaimRisk: Must be claimed in the Qoder app, opened it for you
qoderLaunchFailed: Qoder app not found, opened the website
qoderAutoClaimOff: Auto-claim is off (set it under Daily schedule)
qoderAutoClaimHint: At the scheduled time the app calls the claim API. If risk control blocks it, open the card and claim manually (no silent app launch).
qoderClaimAllHint: Claim once for each claimable Qoder account on the board
dailyTodoHint: Run unfinished WorkBuddy check-ins and Qoder claims for today, in that order.
